features: Adds Delete Draft to active Saved Rounds while keeping Open available for normal scoring continuation
Draft deletion inspects competitors, judges, marks, calculated results, Final pairings, Final marks and Final results before deletion
Drafts containing scoring data show a strong warning and require typing DELETE before permanent removal
Deleting a Draft removes only its scoring workflow data; the underlying Event record is preserved
After Draft deletion the same Event + Dance Style + Division becomes available for a new scoring workflow
Prevents duplicate scoring creation for an Event + Dance Style + Division while an existing workflow remains
An event can still host other independent Dance Style or Division workflows
Delete Draft is unavailable after the workflow progresses beyond Draft/Discarded and Completed or Published events remain protected
Completed and Published events remain excluded from the active Scoring Dashboard and are handled through Completed Events
The proven scoring core remains unchanged
